feed.title: John Deere’s Row Crop Iron Horses
feed.summary: This article highlights how John Deere's "New Generation" and subsequent 30 and 40 Series tractor introductions significantly boosted its North American market share. It details the innovations and key features of these tractors, including the Sound-Gard cabs and the robust Model 466 diesel engine, particularly focusing on the popular 4440 model. The article also discusses advancements in transmissions and hydraulics, alongside the challenges faced with the Hydraulic Front-Wheel Assist system.
